Big Gorilla Tournament Details

Early Rampage Tournament & Deadline:Be one of the first 2,400 teams before June 15 to compete in the Early Rampage Tournament with $25,000 in prizes. See below for Tournament details*
Seven Bananas Promotion:The Seven Bananas promotion rewards users for getting multiple 7th picks in a row across consecutive Big Gorilla drafts. See below for promo details**
Entry Fee:$350 Live and Slow online drafts
Multiple Team Discount Pricing:$1,000 for a three pack of teams ($50 discount)
Contest Capacity:Maximum of 18,000 entries
Prizes:All prizes guaranteed regardless of final entries. Scroll down for details
Draft Positions:Drawn at random & emailed to league, when league is full
Draft Type & Length:20 round serpentine (snake) online draft
Live online drafts with a 60 second timer
Slow online drafts with a 1***, 2, 4, or 6 hour timer (Overnight pause from 2-8 AM ET)
Number of teams:12
Duration:Regular season Weeks 1-12. League Playoffs Weeks 13-14. Championship Round weeks 15-17
Format (Regular Season):Weeks 1-12
H2H matchups
After Week 12, League Playoff standings will be decided as such:
Seed 1) Team with best regular season Record
Seed 2) Team with highest point total
Seed 3) The remaining team with the best regular season record
Seed 4) The remaining team with the highest point total
Format (League Playoffs):Weeks 13-14
Weekly H2H matchups decide League Champion
The top two (2) seeds of each League in the regular season earn an Automatic Berth into the Championship Round. The League Champion also earns a berth into the Championship Round
Format (Championship Round):Weeks 15-17
No H2H matchups, total points only
Team with the highest sum of total points scored from Week 15-17 added to their one-game point average from the regular season is the Big Gorilla Champion
Free Agency:Waivers by way of blind bidding (FAAB)
Each team gets $1000 blind bidding “dollars” for entire season
Two (2) weekly free agencies on Wednesday & Sunday
First free agency is scheduled on the Wednesday after Labor Day (September 9)
All bids must be entered by Wednesday 11 PM ET and Sunday 10 AM ET
Weekly Team Management:Yes. Starting lineups and free agency
Week One Free Agency Rule:Due to the NFL opening their season on Wednesday night, September 9, the first free agency will be scheduled at 10 AM ET on that day for all leagues that completed their draft September 8 or prior. All bids must be entered by 10 AM ET on Wednesday, September 9, for the first waiver run of the season. There will not be an 11 PM ET run on Wednesday, September 9, only a 10 AM waiver run. This rule is for Week One only.
Week One Lineup Rules:All teams, whether drafting before or after NFL Week One opening game on Wednesday, will be able to submit and edit their starting lineup after Wednesday's game, including start/bench players which played in Wednesday's and Thursday's game. To confirm, all Big Gorilla teams will have the same choice on whether to start or sit Wednesday and Thursday players retroactively after they have watched that game. Fantasy stats for Wednesday's and Thursday's players will count towards Week One scores if they are placed in the starting lineup.
Trades:No trading allowed
Scoring System:FFPC Scoring rules will be in effect (scroll down for scoring details)
Roster Requirement:Twenty (20) total roster spots
Starting Lineup:1-QB, 2-RB, 2-WR, 1-TE, 2-Flex, 1-K, 1-D (Flex can be RB, WR or TE)

*The Early Rampage Tournament is an early bird promotion and is a ‘contest within a contest’ for teams which enter the Big Gorilla at any point on or before June 15th and draft anytime on or before June 30th. The first 200 filled leagues (2,400 teams) will be entered into the Early Rampage Tournament to compete for the $25,000 prize pool (see below for details). These teams will qualify for the Early Rampage Championship just as they would qualify for the Big Gorilla Championship in Weeks 15-17, i.e. finishing top two in their league or winning their league playoffs. The Early Rampage Championship prizes are in addition to the Big Gorilla Championship prizes and are exclusive to the first qualifying 200 leagues (or any leagues filled prior to June 15, if less than 200 leagues are filled). The Early Rampage Tournament is available for all FFPC team owners, new and existing. There is no entry limit per team owner. All entries whether using cash, account funds or contest credits are eligible. Please view the rules page for full details.

**The Seven Bananas promotion rewards teams for getting multiple 7-picks in a row across consecutive Big Gorilla drafts of which the user is a participant. To qualify for the promo, the 7-picks must be acquired in CONSECUTIVE filled drafts (draft orders must be randomized consecutively). Just get two 7-picks in a row and win a $125 Best Ball Tournament credit! You can even win an all-expense paid Jungle Safari for four or $50,000 in cash! Please view the rules page for full details.

Seven Bananas promo prizes are as follows:

Bananas (Consecutive 7th picks)Prize

2-Bananas

One (1) FFPC $125 league credit ($125 value)

3-Bananas

One (1) Main Event Entry ($2,200 value)

4-Bananas

One (1) High Society League Entry ($10,000 value)

5-Bananas

Jungle Safari for four OR $50,000 cash

***1 Hour Slow drafts will ONLY be available as the NFL Season approaches, if necessary, once 2-, 4- and 6-hour slow drafts close.

The Seven Bananas Promotion will end on September 3, 2026, for any teams with zero bananas. Teams with one or more bananas will continue to have the promotion applied to their subsequent draft(s), provided bananas continue to be awarded.

To clarify, if a user has two bananas and registers for a Big Gorilla draft on September 4, that user remains eligible to earn a third banana. If the user earns a third banana, they will then be eligible to earn a fourth banana in their next draft, and so on. If the user does not earn the third banana, their banana streak ends, and they will no longer be eligible to earn bananas in future Big Gorilla drafts for the 2026 NFL season.

FFPC reserves the right to extend the promotion.

The Seven Bananas promotion resets annually. Bananas do not carry over from year-to-year.
